title: Princess Y85
highlights: Hardtop with electric awning and tilting louvres
description:
A special opportunity to own a like-new 2024 Princess Y85, with twin MAN V12 1,900 HP engines showing only 176 hours. She has an outstanding specification with every option included.

Outside: hydraulic bathing platform and passerelle, stern docking winches, a third control station and a hardtop with electric sun awning and tilting louvres. Inside: satin walnut woods, a circular extending dining table, electric midship doors and a fully equipped galley.
